name: worklane
description: Read and change your Worklane studio, including notes, documents, and the records the screens do not add up.

interface.shortDescription: Read and change studio records you already have access to.
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to Worklane. Signing in on the Connect page shares read access. Allowing changes lets the assistant create, update, and send using the same access you already have. You can disconnect later.
defaultPrompt: What studios can I see in Worklane?
